credentials.title: On-chain from day one
credentials.body: Enrolment, soulbound XP as a Token-2022 mint, and credential NFTs issued straight to the learner's wallet — verifiable by anyone, owned by nobody else.

forum.title: Community forum
forum.body: Ask, answer, vote and accept — with XP for the people who help. Peer learning next to the lessons instead of somewhere else.

leagues.title: Cohort leagues
leagues.body: Weekly leagues on the leaderboard, plus a strip showing the three learners either side of you, so progress is measured against peers rather than against the all-time top.

ladder.title: The five-course ladder is complete
ladder.body: "Solana for Web Developers" joined the path, so Zero to Deployed now runs end to end: client and transactions, Rust, your first program, a published SDK and dApp, and getting paid in stablecoins.

aiTutor.title: AI tutor with limits you can see
aiTutor.body: A free tier of assists per lesson, a Socratic mode that keeps going when they run out, a handoff to the forum, and counters that tell you exactly where you stand. Nothing is for sale and nothing is hidden.

reminders.title: Study reminders by email
reminders.body: Opt-in reminders built around the daily goal you set at sign-up. Off by default, one toggle to stop.

evm.title: "Solana for EVM Developers" elective
evm.body: Written and sitting in the content bundle for developers arriving from Ethereum. It goes live once it's activated on-chain.

notifications.title: Notifications beyond email
notifications.body: In-app notifications for the things you actually asked to hear about — answers to your questions, credentials minted, quests about to reset.

intro.lede: Getting a course to learners takes two separate steps, in order. This screen holds both: publish on top, deploy below.
intro.step1Title: 1. Publish — does the app have this course?
intro.step1Body: Course content lives in the academy-courses repo. The app ships a compiled copy of it, pinned to one commit in content.lock. Publishing is a human pull request that bumps that pin and rebuilds the bundle; once it merges, Vercel redeploys and the content is in the app. This screen writes nothing — it shows the drift and hands you a prefilled PR.
intro.step2Title: 2. Deploy — is the course on chain, and can learners see it?
intro.step2Body: Content sitting in the bundle stays invisible until the course has an on-chain account and is active. Deploying creates or updates that account. Only on-chain fields matter here: XP per lesson, creator reward, minimum completions, lesson count, and the immutable set (creator, difficulty, track, track level, prerequisite).
intro.contentOnlyNote: Editing lesson content — prose, code, quizzes, the title, tags — is not on chain. Those edits go live on publish alone, and correctly show nothing to deploy below. A course still reading "Synced" after you rewrote a lesson is not a bug.

coursesScreen.step1Eyebrow: Step 1 — Publish: get the content into the app
coursesScreen.step2Eyebrow: Step 2 — Deploy: put the course on chain

legend.title: What the states mean
legend.description: Every course row carries an on-chain state, and — once deployed — a content-drift state. They are independent.
legend.not_deployed: Never deployed. The course is in the bundle but has no on-chain account, so learners cannot see it. Deploy creates it.
legend.synced: On chain, and its on-chain fields match the bundle. Nothing to do.
legend.out_of_sync: On chain, but an on-chain field (XP per lesson, creator reward, minimum completions, lesson count) differs from the bundle. Deploy again to update it.
legend.draft: Marked as a draft in the content repo. Not deployable until it is no longer a draft.
legend.missing_fields: The bundle is missing on-chain fields this course needs before it can be deployed. The row lists which ones.
legend.drifted: The content repo has moved ahead of the pinned commit. The fix is a publish PR (step 1), not a deploy.
legend.blocked: Newer content exists upstream, but its CI is red. Do not publish it until CI is green.
legend.unknown: GitHub could not be reached, so drift could not be checked. The on-chain state is still accurate.
legend.immutableTitle: Immutable mismatch (no badge — the row shows a warning instead)
legend.immutableBody: Creator, difficulty, track, track level and prerequisite are written once, at first deploy, and can never be changed. If one of them differs from the bundle, the Deploy button disappears — an update cannot fix it. The only remedies are to restore the value in the content repo, or deactivate this course and deploy a new one.

recreate.cardIntro: These fields are set once at deploy and update_course cannot change them. The only fix is to close and recreate the on-chain course.
recreate.creatorEmphasis: Creator mismatch: Course.creator is the immutable XP-reward recipient. Until the course is recreated, every creator reward pays the wrong wallet.
recreate.loadErrorHeading: Could not check the recreate preflight

refusalReason.noImmutableDiff: No immutable field differs between the content bundle and the on-chain account — a recreate would fix nothing and would irreversibly reset the on-chain completion/enrollment counters and cause downtime.
refusalReason.unconfirmed: Could not read the on-chain account to confirm an immutable mismatch — refresh the status screen and retry; refusing to recreate on unconfirmed state.

modal.title: Recreate “{title}”
modal.intro: This closes the on-chain course account and creates it again to rewrite the immutable fields below. It is the platform's most destructive on-chain operation.
modal.immutableHeading: Immutable fields this recreate will set
modal.lessonCountLabel: On-chain lesson count is preserved exactly ({count}). New lessons are added afterwards via the ordinary sync.
modal.resetCounters: On-chain counters (total completions/enrollments shown on the course) reset to 0 — unrecoverable.
modal.preserveList: Learner records in the database — enrollments, lesson progress, certificates — are untouched.
modal.downtimeWarning: Brief downtime: close and create are NOT atomic — there is a seconds-long window where the course PDA is absent and enroll/complete will fail.
modal.unusualDescription: The resolved creator is on the denylist or equals the platform authority — normally refused by the #427 guard.

resync.heading: Data Resync
resync.description: Rebuild a user's Supabase data from on-chain state: XP balance (Token-2022 ATA), enrollments & lesson progress (Enrollment PDAs + bitmap), achievements (AchievementReceipt PDAs) & certificates (Enrollment credential_asset). Use after webhook failures or for migration.

flags.description: Community posts reported by users. Resolve once you've actioned the content, or dismiss if the report isn't valid.
flags.errorFetch: Failed to update the flag. Please try again.

insightsScreen.title: Insights
insightsScreen.subtitle: Aggregate platform behaviour — AI-tutor usage and learning activity. No per-learner data.
insightsScreen.quizNote: Quiz correctness is tracked as the quiz_checked product-analytics event (PostHog) — it is not persisted server-side, so it appears in PostHog dashboards rather than here.

screen1.title: Have you shipped code before?
screen1.subtitle: This just points you at the right first lesson — you can change course anytime.

jsTs.label: I've shipped apps with JavaScript or TypeScript
jsTs.desc: You already code — Solana's model is the new part.

web3.label: I've written smart contracts or shipped on-chain
web3.desc: Skip the basics and go straight to building on Solana.

new.label: I haven't written code professionally yet
new.desc: Start from the ground up, one lesson at a time.

referral.title: One honest heads-up
referral.body: Every course here assumes you already write JavaScript. We do not teach programming from scratch yet — freeCodeCamp does, and does it well. Come back when JavaScript feels comfortable; you are welcome to look around in the meantime.

screen2.title: What are you here to do?
screen2.subtitle: We'll frame your path around it.

job.desc: Build a portfolio of on-chain work and a verifiable credential.

build.label: Ship my own project
build.desc: Get to a working Solana app or protocol as fast as possible.

explore.label: Understand how Solana works
explore.desc: Learn the concepts at your own pace, no pressure.

screen3.title: What are you into?
screen3.subtitle: Optional — pick any that fit, or skip. It helps us tune examples.

screen4.title: Set a daily goal
screen4.subtitle: A small daily target beats the occasional marathon. You can change it later.

testOut.title: Test out of {course}
testOut.subtitle: Already know this material? Pass a short challenge to skip ahead — you'll still earn the full XP for every lesson.
testOut.signInHint: Your progress and XP are tied to your account.
testOut.loadError: We couldn't load the challenge. Please try again.
testOut.intro: Answer these {count} questions. Get at least {required} right to test out.
testOut.passedBody: Every lesson in this course is now complete and its XP is on the way. Taking you to what's next…
testOut.failedBody: No problem — work through the course and try again anytime. Nothing was lost.
testOut.submitError: We couldn't submit your answers. Please try again.
testOut.unavailableBody: This course doesn't offer a test-out right now. Open it and work through the lessons instead — you'll earn XP for each one.
